name: claude-code-switcher
description: Switch the Claude Code chat panel between configurable provider presets, with DeepSeek included.

commands.title: Claude Code Switcher: Reset Preset API Key

claudeCodeSwitcher.presets.markdownDescription: Provider presets for Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Edit in User Settings JSON. The built-in `deepseek` preset is merged with your overrides; set it to `null` to hide it. New IDs add presets. Keys are prompted for and saved separately. After editing, select the preset again and reload the window.

label.description: Name shown in the preset picker and status bar.

apiKeyEnv.description: Variable receiving the separately stored API key. Use none for an endpoint that needs no key.

environment.description: Environment variables for this preset. ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is required for new presets. Values are strings; null removes an inherited value. Do not put credentials here. Cloud-provider routing flags must remain 0.

claudeCodeSwitcher.statusBarColors.markdownDescription: Status bar text and icon colors by preset ID. Use `claude` for the restored Claude configuration and `custom` for an unmatched provider. Values are six-digit hex colors or `null` to use the VS Code theme color. Changes apply immediately.

claudeCodeSwitcher.statusBarAlignment.description: Position of the status bar item

scripts.lint: node --check extension.js && node --check deepseek-rate.js && node --check presets.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Provider switching changes the Claude Code extension's credentials and connection settings.
